title: My Stepsister Forged A Sale, Stole My Mom’s Dolls, And Threw Them Away. So I Let Her Dust Them.
description: When my mom passed, her will left me her vintage Barbie doll collection worth $200,000, but my stepsister, the executor, forged a $1 sale note and sold everything to a collector for $240,000. I found a voicemail from my mom assigning the dolls to me, voided the sale in probate, and now run a doll museum where my stepsister wears a 'Plastic Promises' smock and dusts the dolls every day. Each doll’s packaging features a QR code that links directly to her fraud conviction. #DollhouseOfDeceit #FamilyBetrayal #RevengeStory
thumb_text: SHE TOSSED MY DOLLS, NOW DUSTS THEM DAILY
pinned_comment: If your stepsister forged a $1 sale note and stole your mother’s $200,000 doll collection, what would you have done? Share your story if this happened to you in the comments.
